projects.title: LayerRemix
projects.lead: A platform where artists share, download and remix each other’s Photoshop files.
projects.body: Most design work ends as a flattened JPG. LayerRemix keeps the layers alive: designers upload working PSDs, others download the real source file, rework it, and publish the remix back. Every fork is versioned and linked to the original, so a single file becomes a visible lineage of who built what. I designed, built and run it solo.
